description: Source code for the AIROC Wi-Fi driver for Infineon hardware, implementing Wi-Fi management functions including scan, connect, disconnect, and access point mode, with integration to Zephyr OS networking stack.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_get_whd_interface
methods.description: Returns the current Wi-Fi driver interface object.

methods.name: convert_whd_security_to_zephyr
methods.description: Converts WHD security types to Zephyr Wi-Fi security types.

methods.name: parse_scan_result
methods.description: Parses a WHD scan result into Zephyr Wi-Fi scan result structure.

methods.name: scan_callback
methods.description: Handles scan result callbacks from WHD.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_host_buffer_get
methods.description: Allocates a network buffer for WHD.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_buffer_release
methods.description: Releases a network buffer used by WHD.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_buffer_get_current_piece_data_pointer
methods.description: Gets data pointer from a buffer.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_buffer_get_current_piece_size
methods.description: Gets size of data in a buffer.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_buffer_set_size
methods.description: Sets size of a buffer.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_buffer_add_remove_at_front
methods.description: Adds or removes data at the front of a buffer.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_send
methods.description: Sends a network packet via Wi-Fi.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_network_process_ethernet_data
methods.description: Processes received Ethernet data from Wi-Fi.

methods.name: link_events_handler
methods.description: Handles link events from WHD.

methods.name: airoc_event_task
methods.description: Event processing task for Wi-Fi events.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_init
methods.description: Initializes Wi-Fi management interface.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_scan
methods.description: Performs Wi-Fi network scan.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_connect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_ap_link_events_handler
methods.description: Handles access point link events.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_ap_enable
methods.description: Enables Wi-Fi access point mode.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_wifi_stats
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi statistics.

methods.name: airoc_mgmt_ap_disable
methods.description: Disables Wi-Fi access point mode.

methods.name: airoc_init
methods.description: Performs driver initialization.
